description:
EXPERIMENTAL — Retrieve cached company search results by search ID.

Every company_search_person and company_search_company call returns
a search_id. Use this tool to retrieve those results again without
re-running the search.

Examples:
  company_search_result("abc123-def456")

api_key.description: Your Ohmyfin API key (prod-...). Optional here: it can be sent instead as a KEY header or an Authorization: Bearer header. What the tool requires of the key is in its description.

search_id.description: The search_id returned by a previous company_search_person or company_search_company call.

name: company_search_result
title: Company Search Result (Experimental)
